chunks: Except those who believe and do the right, for whom there is reward undiminished.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for receiving an undiminished reward in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to Surah Al-Bayyinah (98:8), emphasizing that true faith (Iman) must be accompanied by righteous action (Amal al-Salih) to secure an 'unending' (Ghayr Mamnun) reward. This condition underscores the Shia principle of the unity of knowledge and action, where deeds serve as the fruit of faith, ensuring the reward is not merely granted but sustained eternally in the Hereafter.
